Idrottsförening | nickname = | founded = {{Start date and age|1939|4|1|df=y}} | ground = [[Strandvallen]] | capacity = 6,750 | chairman = Jan Sjöblom | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Andreas Brännström]] | league = [[Allsvenskan]] | season = [[2025 Allsvenskan|2025]] | position = Allsvenskan, 1st of 16 (champions) | website = {{URL|http://www.maif.se/index.php|maif.se}} | current = 2026 Mjällby AIF season | pattern_la1 = _maif24h | pattern_b1 = _maif24h | pattern_ra1 = _maif24h | leftarm1 = 000000 | body1 = FFEE00 | rightarm1 = 000000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFEE00 | pattern_la2 = _pumagoal23w | pattern_b2 = _pumagoal24w | pattern_ra2 = _pumagoal23w | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Mjällby Allmänna Idrottsförening''', also known simply as '''Mjällby AIF''', '''Mjällby''' ({{IPA|sv|ˈmjɛ̌lːbʏ|}} {{respell|M'YELL|bih}}) or (especially locally) '''Maif''' or MAIF''',{{efn-ua|In the media, "Mjällby AIF" is normally abbreviated "Maif", in accordance with Swedish writing standards that state that acronyms that are pronounced as a word, as opposed to letter by letter, should be spelled with the first letter in upper case and the remaining in lower case, thus "Maif". However, some fans of the club, as well as the club itself, prefer to use only uppercase, "MAIF", even though they also pronounce it as a word: {{IPA|sv|maj:f|}}.}}''' is a Swedish professional [[association football|football club]] based in [[Hällevik]], Mjällby parish, in [[Sölvesborg Municipality]] which currently plays in Sweden's highest football league, [[Allsvenskan]]. The club is affiliated to [[Blekinge Fotbollförbund]] and plays its home games at [[Strandvallen]]. The club colours, reflected in their crest and kit, are yellow and black. Formed on 1 April 1939, the club has played thirteen seasons in Allsvenskan. The club's first season in the top league was in [[1980 Allsvenskan|1980]]. Mjällby AIF is the most successful football team from the province of [[Blekinge]]. Former [[Sweden men's national football team]] players [[Christian Wilhelmsson]] and [[Mattias Asper]] began their careers at the club. Both players also ended their playing careers in Mjällby. On 18 May 2023, Mjällby AIF played the [[2023 Svenska Cupen final|Swedish Cup final]] at Strandvallen, losing 1–4 to [[BK Häcken]].{{cite news|url=https://www.svt.se/sport/fotboll/hacken-vinner-tredje-cuptiteln|title=Häcken vinner tredje cuptiteln|work=SVT Sport|first1=Martin |last1=Aghassi|first2=Therese |last2=Bosta|first3=Rani |last3=Amir|language=sv|date=18 May 2023|accessdate=21 May 2023|archive-date=21 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230521071650/https://www.svt.se/sport/fotboll/hacken-vinner-tredje-cuptiteln|url-status=live}} On 20 October 2025, Mjällby AIF secured its first [[List of Swedish football champions|Swedish Championship title]] with three games remaining in the [[2025 Allsvenskan]].{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2025/oct/20/mjallby-win-unlikely-swedish-title-allsvenskan-football|title='It's all just wonderful': minnows Mjällby win unlikely Swedish title for first time|work=The Guardian|agency=Reuters|date=20 October 2025|accessdate=20 October 2025}}{{cite news|url=https://www.sverigesradio.se/artikel/mjallby-svenska-mastare-sensationen-ett-faktum|title=Mjällby svenska mästare|work=Radiosporten|first=Andreas |last=Lundin|language=sv|date=20 October 2025|accessdate=20 October 2025}} On 15 May 2026, Mjällby played another cup final, resulting in a 2–1 win against [[Hammarby Fotboll|Hammarby IF]],{{Cite web |last=Nordqvist |first=Casper |date=2026-05-14 |title=Mjällby cupmästare – slog Hammarby i finalen |url=https://fotbolldirekt.se/svenska-cupen/just-nu-mjallby-cupmastare-slog-hammarby-i-finalen/ |access-date=2026-05-21 |website=FotbollDirekt |language=sv-SE}}{{Cite web |date=2026-05-14 |title=Mjällby cupmästare – knäckte Bajen i finalen |url=https://www.expressen.se/sport/fotboll/allsvenskan/mjallby-cupmastare-vann-finalen-mot-hammarby/ |access-date=2026-05-21 |website=www.expressen.se |language=sv}} leading to their first ever Swedish cup victory. Mjällby will play in the [[2026-27 UEFA Conference League]] [[2026–27 UEFA Conference League league phase|league phase]], marking their first ever appearance in European football."}}
